name: msilabs/bkash
description: bKash Tokenized Checkout v2 for Laravel. Create, execute, query and search payments, with full and partial refunds and agreement (one-click) payments.
features: Multiple merchants, from config or the database at runtime
Bangla error messages, API logging with secrets masked

name: @msilabs/bkash
description: A server-side bKash Tokenized Checkout v2 client for Node.js, Bun, Deno and edge runtimes. Create, execute, query and search payments, with refunds and agreement (one-click) payments.
features: confirmPayment() checks the real status when execute fails or times out
Token caching with a pluggable store (Redis, KV) for serverless and edge
Bangla error messages, API logging with secrets masked
Works with Express, NestJS, Next.js, Hono and more
